scope: Read-only bounded check for campaign-owned disposable Chrome profiles under the current user's OS temporary directory. No deletion, mutation, browser launch, preflight, credential or user-data inspection occurred.

verified_profile_prefixes.ownership_and_cleanup: The harness creates its root with mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), launches Chrome with profile=<root>/profile, stops only its spawned ChildProcess, and removes exactly that root in finally (line 475).
The diagnostic creates the root with mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), puts its persistent Chrome profile under root/profile, closes its own context, then removes exactly its root in finally (line 471).
The diagnostic creates the persistent Chrome profile with mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), closes its own context and removes exactly that profile in finally.

live_process_check.method: Read current user's process command-line metadata only and match the three exact campaign prefixes; raw command lines were not emitted.
live_process_check.result: No live current-user process command line references a verified campaign prefix in this OS temp directory.

conclusion: No safely attributable campaign-owned disposable Chrome profile remains under the current user's internal OS temp directory. There is no candidate space to reclaim from these verified prefixes; the internal volume remains about 7.97 GiB below the 20 GiB floor.
limitations: The check is intentionally limited to the current user's OS temp directory and three source-verified campaign prefixes. It does not infer ownership of arbitrary directories or inspect browser userdata contents.
Candidates were absent, so there were no candidate sizes to measure.
